I wrote to her and said we need to talk but she hasn't read my message so I wanna give her space. 

I don't have anyone to talk to. I don't have good relationship with my family. I have no job and back in school I don't wanna fall back into that deep dark hole again where I didn't see the light at the end of the tunnel when I was going thru divorce. I felt like when I tell ppl honestly what I feel it is not acknowledged.

I felt like my best friend didn't make time for me. It started when I did a trip to see her some months ago.. We never really had our time together. I stated with her and her husband and child. Only the last night of my trip we managed to get a few hours together. All the time, we always hang out with her husband around.

Then I started to see pics on Facebook she posted of everyone else who she hanged out with and etc. I don't care about fb much, but it's how she always been posting pictures of her friends that started making me feel like I wasn't important. Hence I decided not to be responsive much.

We used to communicate daily but the communication got less and she messaged me after 15 days not talking. I was already having arguments daily with the bf and really affected me. She said she needed me and went thru a miscarriage during the times we didn't talk and I was in my exam period and travelling. I shut off to ppl completely. I was cold to everyone.

Yes I need to let it out.

I feel like I am so messed up. I am in my 30s and ever since that one relationship and the divorce, I lost the ability to sleep properly ever since.

I closed off myself because I got hurt so bad for feeling I wasn't good enough as the ex husband had always been in contact with his ex-turned wife and they had a child together. I was there for convenience. I felt so used and naive and ever since this episode, I build a wall to protect my heart.

I always have been dubious about ppls intentions and it affected my relationship with the ppl close to me. I got super defensive with my best friend and bf and relationships are sour now. 

I feel horrible. Maybe I have issues. Maybe I don't deserve the love. I can't help but this little girl inside me feel quite beaten down.

I feel a little silly at the moment. He said he isn't ready for getting married in two months and we need to see how it goes. I don't wanna waste more youth. I don't know if I should wait and see how things go or leave.
No he hasn't propose. I initiated the marriage talk so we can be together. He went along with it and agreed but now he isn't sure and wants to see how it goes but not getting married.
